mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals increased economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% MoM signals robust economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both RSAFS and PAYEMS increase by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% MoM signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% QoQ signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% QoQ.
